scenario: When a vendor invoice PDF arrives in the AP inbox in Gmail, look up the referenced PO in the purchasing sheet, create a bill in QuickBooks if amounts match within tolerance, and post a mismatch note to the #ap-exceptions Slack channel otherwise.

When an employee submits an expense report in the expense tool, check each line against the per-diem and category limits in the policy sheet, approve compliant reports, and route over-limit ones to the employee's manager via Slack with flagged lines.
When a Stripe payout notification email arrives, match the customer payments to open invoices in Xero, mark matched invoices paid, and update the AR aging sheet.
rule_hooks: invoice number or amount matching rules

scenario: When an invoice in QuickBooks crosses 30, 60, or 90 days past due, send the matching dunning email template to the customer's billing contact and log the touch on the HubSpot company record.
rule_hooks: aging bucket to dunning template map

scenario: When a customer's overdue balance exceeds their credit limit, set the Salesforce account's credit status to 'Hold', notify the account owner in Slack, and add a row to the credit-hold tracker sheet.
When a signed W-9 comes back through DocuSign, create the vendor in QuickBooks with the tax ID and 1099 flag, update the vendor onboarding sheet to 'Complete', and email the requesting buyer.

When a vendor emails a request to change remittance bank details, place the vendor's pending payments on hold in the AP sheet, open a verification task in Asana for a callback, and alert the AP lead in Slack.
When a department's month-to-date actuals in the budget-vs-actuals sheet exceed 90% of its monthly budget, email the department head and the FP&A analyst with the variance and top spending vendors.
When a Salesforce opportunity moves to Closed Won, create the customer and first invoice in QuickBooks using the deal's billing terms, and post the invoice number to the deal's Slack channel.

When a Zendesk ticket is tagged 'refund_request', look up the order and payment in the billing sheet, issue a credit memo in Xero if under the agent's approval limit, and reply on the ticket; otherwise escalate to the finance manager.

When a new bill is entered in QuickBooks, search recent bills for the same vendor, amount, and invoice number, and if a likely duplicate exists void the payment schedule entry and notify the AP clerk in Slack.

When a capital expenditure request form is submitted in Google Forms, add it to the capex register sheet and route it via email to the approver tier based on amount, creating an approval task in Monday.com.

When a bill coded to equipment over the capitalization threshold is approved in QuickBooks, add the item to the fixed asset register sheet with its useful life and notify the controller to reclassify it from expense.
rule_hooks: capitalization threshold and asset class useful lives

scenario: When an intercompany invoice is created in one entity's Xero, create the matching bill in the counterparty entity's ledger and log both references in the intercompany reconciliation sheet.

When a customer signs a renewal amendment in DocuSign, update the subscription price and term in the billing sheet, adjust the recurring invoice template in QuickBooks, and notify the revenue accountant.

When a new customer is created in HubSpot with a shipping address, look up the applicable sales tax rate by state and nexus status, set the tax code on the QuickBooks customer, and flag exemption-certificate needs.
rule_hooks: state nexus and tax rate table

scenario: When a customer emails a sales tax exemption certificate, verify its expiration and state, mark the customer tax-exempt in QuickBooks, store the certificate link in the exemption tracker sheet, and reply confirming.
When a corporate card transaction posts in the card feed sheet without an attached receipt after 7 days, send a Slack DM to the cardholder requesting it and mark the transaction 'Receipt Requested'.

When the daily bank statement CSV lands in Google Drive, compare cleared transactions to QuickBooks entries, mark matched ones reconciled in the rec sheet, and create a Jira ticket for each unmatched item over $500.

When a payment request for an outbound wire is submitted in the AP tracker, check the amount against the dual-approval threshold and send approval requests to one or two approvers via email, updating the request status accordingly.

When the daily cash position sheet shows an operating account below its minimum balance, email the treasurer with the shortfall and the suggested sweep amount from the reserve account, and log it in the treasury log.

When a foreign-currency vendor invoice is received by email, look up the month's booking rate in the FX rates sheet, record the bill in Xero with the converted amount, and note the rate used in the AP log.

When a project manager marks a service PO as 'Work Delivered' in Asana but no invoice exists by month-end, add an accrual line to the month-end accruals sheet and notify the GL accountant to book the journal entry.
rule_hooks: accrual policy and GL account mapping

scenario: When a manual journal entry is submitted for review in the JE log sheet, check whether it exceeds the review threshold or hits restricted accounts, assign the reviewer accordingly, and Slack them with the entry details.
rule_hooks: JE review thresholds and restricted accounts

scenario: When the external auditor emails a new PBC (provided-by-client) request, add it to the PBC tracker sheet with a due date, assign the owner based on the request area, and create a task in ClickUp for them.

When a Stripe dispute notification email arrives, look up the order and delivery evidence in the orders sheet, open a Freshdesk ticket for the response, mark the invoice disputed in QuickBooks, and notify the AR lead.
rule_hooks: dispute reason codes and response deadlines

scenario: When cumulative payments to a 1099-eligible vendor in the vendor payments sheet cross $600 for the year, flag the vendor in QuickBooks for 1099 reporting and email them if no W-9 is on file.

When an expense report reaches 'Approved' status, add the reimbursement to the next payroll reimbursement batch sheet based on the cutoff date and send the employee a confirmation with the expected pay date.

When a customer emails AR asking to change their billing contact, verify the sender's domain against the HubSpot company record, update the invoice email in QuickBooks and HubSpot, and reply confirming the change.

When an approved bill in QuickBooks has terms like 2/10 net 30, schedule it in the payment run sheet for the discount date and note the discount amount, alerting AP if the discount window closes within two days.

When a customer cancellation is logged in Intercom, compute the prorated credit from the contract terms in the billing sheet, issue a credit note in Xero, and post the revenue impact in the #finance-revenue Slack channel.
rule_hooks: proration and refund terms by plan

scenario: When an annual prepaid invoice is marked paid in QuickBooks, add a monthly recognition schedule to the deferred revenue sheet and create a recurring calendar reminder for the revenue accountant.

When an employee submits a travel booking request via Google Form, check the destination and cost against the travel policy sheet, approve within-policy trips automatically, and email the manager for out-of-policy ones.
rule_hooks: travel policy cost caps by region

scenario: When a SaaS vendor sends an auto-renewal notice email, look up the contract owner and budget line in the software inventory sheet, notify the owner on Slack to confirm or cancel, and mark the renewal 'Pending Decision'.
rule_hooks: renewal notice lead time and budget owner

scenario: When a new bill is imported into Xero without an account code, apply the GL account and department from the vendor coding rules sheet, and route uncoded vendors to the AP specialist via Slack.

When a customer's autopay fails and a decline email arrives from the payment processor, mark the invoice 'Payment Failed' in the AR sheet, email the customer an update-payment-method link, and log a task on the HubSpot contact.
rule_hooks: retry schedule and decline code handling

scenario: When a close checklist task is marked done in Monday.com, update the close status sheet, notify the next dependent task's owner in Slack, and alert the controller if the task finished after its deadline.

When an office manager logs a petty cash count in the petty cash sheet showing the balance below the float minimum, create a replenishment request in the AP tracker and email the office's finance approver.
rule_hooks: petty cash float limits per office

scenario: When a vendor emails their monthly account statement, compare listed open invoices to the vendor's open bills in QuickBooks, record discrepancies in the vendor rec sheet, and reply to the vendor requesting missing invoice copies.

When an expense is coded to a grant-funded project in the project cost sheet, check the category against the grant's allowable cost list, reclassify disallowed items to the general fund in Xero, and notify the grants accountant.

A vendor emails a credit memo PDF for returned goods. The agent finds the matching open bills in QuickBooks, applies the credit to the oldest eligible bill, and posts a note in the AP Slack channel with the remaining balance.
rule_hooks: credit application order, open bill matching

scenario: A prospect submits a credit application form with trade references and requested terms. The agent records it in the credit review sheet, sets a provisional credit limit in Salesforce based on the requested amount and company size tier, and emails the AR manager for sign-off above the auto-approve limit.

Legal uploads a signed office lease amendment that changes rent and extends the term. The agent updates the lease schedule sheet with the new payments and end date, flags the lease for ASC 842 remeasurement, and creates a task for the lease accountant.

An annual insurance or software invoice over the prepaid threshold is approved in AP. The agent books it to the prepaid account instead of expense, adds a monthly amortization line to the prepaid schedule, and notifies the GL accountant.

The payroll provider emails the payroll register for a completed pay run. The agent drafts the payroll journal entry in Xero, splitting wages, taxes, and benefits by department cost center, and posts the draft link to the close channel for review.
rule_hooks: payroll GL mapping, department cost centers

scenario: HR marks an employee as terminated in the HRIS. The agent cancels the employee's corporate card, lists their unsubmitted card transactions and open expense reports, and emails the manager and the payroll team about any amount to recover from the final paycheck.

A court notice arrives saying a customer has filed Chapter 11. The agent places the account on credit hold in the CRM, stops dunning on its open invoices, tags pre-petition balances for bad-debt reserve review, and notifies legal and the account owner.

A customer payment is applied in full to an invoice tied to a closed-won deal. The agent calculates the rep's commission using the plan rate for that product line, adds a row to the commissions payable sheet, and messages the rep and the sales ops lead.

A customer replies to an invoice email disputing one line item. The agent opens a dispute ticket in the helpdesk, pauses dunning on that invoice in the AR tool, and assigns the ticket to the account manager listed in Salesforce.
rule_hooks: dispute reason codes, dunning pause policy

scenario: A state tax agency notice (assessment, penalty, or info request) is scanned into the tax inbox. The agent logs it in the tax notices tracker with jurisdiction, tax type, and amount, creates a calendar deadline for the response date, and assigns it to the tax owner for that jurisdiction.

A vendor's certificate of insurance on file passes its expiration date. The agent puts the vendor's pending payments on hold in the AP system, emails the vendor asking for an updated COI, and notifies the procurement contact.
rule_hooks: required coverage types, payment hold policy

scenario: An outstanding vendor check passes 180 days uncashed on the bank reconciliation. The agent voids it in the accounting system, moves the amount to unclaimed property liability, emails the payee to confirm current remit details, and logs it in the escheatment tracker with the state dormancy date.

A department head submits a mid-quarter reforecast through a form. The agent updates the department's forecast columns in the FP&A sheet, computes the variance against the approved budget, and pings the FP&A partner in Slack if any line moves more than the review threshold.
rule_hooks: variance review threshold, budget owner map

scenario: A hiring manager opens a new job requisition in the recruiting tool. The agent checks the approved headcount plan for that department and level, marks the req as budgeted or unbudgeted, and routes unbudgeted reqs to the CFO for approval.

A project manager marks a contract milestone complete in the project tool. The agent creates the milestone invoice in the billing system for the contracted amount, records the revenue recognition entry on the rev rec sheet, and emails the invoice to the customer's AP contact.

Month-end usage data shows a customer exceeded their plan's included units. The agent calculates the overage at the contracted per-unit rate, adds an overage line to their next invoice, and notifies the customer success manager.

The controller marks the monthly financials as final. The agent pulls EBITDA, debt, and interest figures, computes the leverage and coverage ratios defined in the credit agreement, updates the covenant tracker, and alerts the treasurer if any ratio falls within the warning cushion.

The treasurer posts a request in Slack to draw funds on the revolving credit line. The agent checks the remaining availability and borrowing base in the treasury sheet, drafts the drawdown notice to the bank, and logs the expected funding date in the cash forecast.

The bank sends a confirmation that an FX forward contract settled. The agent records the settlement journal entry with the realized gain or loss against the contracted rate, updates the hedge register, and notifies the treasury analyst.

A collector requests write-off of an uncollectible invoice. The agent checks the amount and aging against the write-off authority matrix, routes it to the right approver, and once approved, posts the write-off against the allowance and closes the collection ticket.

A vendor invoice arrives with no purchase order reference. The agent determines the cost center from the vendor's default coding or the requester named on the invoice, routes the invoice to that cost center's budget owner for approval, and parks it in AP as pending.
rule_hooks: cost center owners, non-PO approval limits

scenario: An independent contractor emails a monthly invoice. The agent compares the billed hours against the approved timesheet entries in the project tool and the rate in their SOW, approves matching invoices for payment, and replies with specific discrepancies otherwise.

A quarterly SOX control's evidence due date passes with nothing uploaded to the controls tracker. The agent marks the control as late, emails the control owner with the evidence requirements, and escalates to the internal audit lead if it is a key control.

An ACH payment batch is released in the AP system. The agent groups the paid bills by vendor and emails each vendor's remittance contact a remittance advice listing invoice numbers, amounts, and any deducted credits.

A customer payment comes in below the invoice amount with a remittance note citing a promotional allowance or damaged goods. The agent applies the partial payment, opens a deduction case for the shortfall with its reason code, and assigns it to sales or logistics depending on the reason.
rule_hooks: deduction reason codes, owner by reason

scenario: Warehouse ops submit cycle count results showing a variance from book quantities. The agent calculates the value of the variance at standard cost, drafts the inventory adjustment entry, and requires the ops director's approval in Slack if it exceeds the materiality threshold.

An invoice arrives from an EU-based vendor for services to the company's EU subsidiary. The agent checks the vendor's VAT status and service type, codes the bill with the reverse-charge tax code instead of charging VAT, and records it in the VAT return workpaper.

A payment is scheduled to a foreign service provider. The agent checks the vendor's W-8BEN on file and the applicable tax treaty rate, reduces the payment by the required withholding, and logs the withheld amount for 1042-S reporting.

A sales rep requests net-90 payment terms on a deal in Salesforce. The agent checks the customer's payment history and the terms approval policy, routes the request to the controller or CFO depending on deal size, and updates the opportunity with the decision.

A customer's procurement portal rejects a submitted invoice for a missing PO number or wrong ship-to entity. The agent looks up the correct PO in the customer's contract record, corrects and resubmits the invoice, and updates the billing profile so future invoices include it.

A vendor notifies the company that it has been acquired and will now invoice under a new legal entity and remit-to address. The agent requests a new W-9, updates the vendor master record, flags open bills for reissue under the new entity, and notifies the contract owner.
rule_hooks: vendor master change policy, TIN validation

scenario: The equity administration platform reports an employee option exercise. The agent records the cash received for the exercise price, calculates the payroll tax withholding on the spread for non-qualified options, and notifies payroll and the stock admin.

An insurer emails that a property damage claim has been paid. The agent matches the incoming deposit, records the recovery against the original loss accounts in the claims tracker, and notifies the risk manager and the controller of any gap between the claim and the payout.

HR creates a new department in the HRIS after a reorganization. The agent creates the matching cost center in the GL, adds a budget line in the FP&A sheet, maps the department's employees for payroll allocation, and confirms the budget owner with the department head.
rule_hooks: cost center numbering, chart of accounts

scenario: An employee's expense report is submitted for a trip that had a cash travel advance. The agent nets the outstanding advance against the reimbursable amount, records any remaining balance owed by the employee, and notifies them and payroll.

Pre-payment screening of a vendor payment flags a possible match on a sanctions list. The agent holds that payment in the payment run, records the screening result and match details, and escalates to the compliance officer before release.
rule_hooks: sanctions list match score, hold policy

scenario: Receiving reports in a Slack channel that a shipment arrived damaged or defective. The agent places the vendor's matching bill on payment hold, emails the vendor requesting a credit or replacement, and opens a tracking task for the buyer.

A key customer emails that a large payment will be delayed several weeks. The agent moves the expected receipt date in the 13-week cash forecast, recomputes the projected minimum balance, and alerts the treasurer if it now falls below the cash buffer.
rule_hooks: cash buffer minimum, forecast week buckets

scenario: Facilities reports in a ticket that equipment was sold or scrapped. The agent finds the asset in the fixed asset register, records the disposal with accumulated depreciation and any sale proceeds, books the gain or loss, and notifies the asset accountant.

A licensee emails its quarterly royalty sales report. The agent calculates the royalty due using the rate and minimum guarantee in the license agreement, creates the invoice in the accounting system, and flags reports that are late or below the minimum.
